hero.alt: Does Eating Break Wudu on a soft green background

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 207
sources.supports: The Prophet ate cooked mutton and prayed without repeating ablution.

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari 211
sources.supports: After drinking milk the Prophet rinsed his mouth; this is distinct from repeating a full wudu.

sources.title: Jami at-Tirmidhi 81
sources.supports: Camel meat is treated separately; the Arabic commentary attributes requiring wudu to Ahmad and Ishaq and notes a contrary view from Sufyan al-Thawri and scholars of Kufa.
